meta_title: MAC Plumbing & Heating | Gas Engineer Nottingham
meta_description: MAC Plumbing & Heating offer expert gas engineering, boiler installs, and heating repairs across Nottingham. Gas Safe registered, free quotes. Call today.
hero_eyebrow: Gas Safe Registered — Free Quotes & Same-Day Callouts
hero_subhead: Boiler broken or heating failing? MAC Plumbing & Heating gets Nottingham homes warm and safe, fast.
services_heading: Complete Plumbing & Heating Services Across Nottingham
services_subhead: From emergency boiler repairs to full central heating installations, MAC Plumbing & Heating covers every gas and plumbing need in Nottingham and the surrounding area.

services.title: Boiler Repair
services.desc: Fast diagnosis and repair of all boiler makes and models, restoring your heating and hot water with minimal disruption. We carry common parts, so most repairs are completed on the first visit.

services.title: Boiler Installation & Replacement
services.desc: Supply and fit of energy-efficient combi, system, and conventional boilers from leading brands. We handle everything from removal of your old unit to full commissioning and warranty registration.

services.title: Central Heating Installation
services.desc: Full central heating system design and installation for new builds, extensions, and older properties upgrading from electric heating. Properly sized radiators and pipework for even heat throughout your home.

services.title: Gas Safety Certificates
services.desc: Annual gas safety inspections and certificates for landlords and homeowners, carried out by our Gas Safe registered engineer. Keep your tenants safe and meet your legal obligations with confidence.

services.title: Boiler Servicing
services.desc: Regular servicing extends boiler life, maintains efficiency, and keeps your manufacturer warranty valid. We provide a thorough check of all components and a full written report on completion.

services.title: Plumbing Repairs & Installations
services.desc: From leaking taps and burst pipes to bathroom suite installations and radiator replacements, we handle all domestic plumbing work to a high standard throughout Nottingham.

about_pullquote: Every job gets the same care I'd give my own home.
about_para_1: MAC Plumbing & Heating was founded in Nottingham with a straightforward aim: to provide honest, reliable gas engineering and plumbing services to local homeowners and landlords. Fully Gas Safe registered and with over a decade of hands-on experience, we've built a solid reputation across the city by doing the job right first time.
about_para_2: We're proud to be a local, independent business — meaning you deal directly with your engineer from the first call to the final sign-off. No call centres, no subcontractors, and no hidden charges. That personal approach is why so many Nottingham customers come back to us year after year and recommend us to their neighbours.
reviews_heading: What Nottingham Homeowners Say About MAC Plumbing & Heating

reviews.text: Brilliant service from start to finish. My boiler packed in on a cold Monday morning and MAC had it sorted by lunchtime. Very fair price and no messing about — will definitely use again.
reviews.author: James T.

reviews.text: Used MAC for a new boiler installation and couldn't be happier. Turned up on time, worked cleanly, and talked me through everything before and after. Highly recommend to anyone in Nottingham.
reviews.author: Claire H.

reviews.text: Needed a gas safety certificate quickly for a rental property. MAC fitted me in within 24 hours, the report was thorough, and the price was very reasonable. Great local business.
reviews.author: David R.
